scope: One fixed24-run synthetic ablation; no patient adapter, original-model comparison or server work
gradient_isolation: eta0 exactly original graph; eta.1 slope below capacity.1 and above1, leaving above-capacity slope unchanged. No new readout, content target or MI critic.
data: 512 training samples,16 tokens per modality,8 tokens per synthetic role. Own-role private factor and shared factor have.05 Gaussian measurement noise; independent nuisance and noise channels. True factors used only for generated event labels and diagnostics.
normalization: Continuous columns2:8 standardized using train-only token moments; exact role metadata columns0:2 retained. Fixed16-row bags give equal patient weight. Held-out data never fit scales.
hazards: factorwise: logits=.3*S+1.2*[P0,P1,Q0,Q1]+[-1.5,-.9,-.3,.3]. paired_xor uses[-P0Q0,-P1Q1,-P0Q1,-P1Q0] instead. All factors signed fair bits; independent censor bins[.1,.1,.1,.7].
optimizer: Adam lr=.003,batch32,500 updates,no clipping or schedule,fixed last checkpoint,no validation model selection
evaluation: Five paired single-draw NLL evaluations averaged, not averaged predictions or5 trainings. All-mean diagnostic is a separate full forward with G mean and private means conditional on that G; not means conditional on sampled G.
secondary_score: Generated observed-bin concordance from risk=-sum survival. Comparable: earlier-bin event, or event versus censor known surviving through the same bin; tied-event bins excluded and tied predictions half credit. Not a clinical C-index result; not used for model selection.
instrument_gate: Before neural fitting: role-placed known factors whole-versus-single relative gain>.25; exact duplicate abs gain<1e-10; independently shuffled factor target abs gain<.05. Fixed192/128/384 partitions, unchanged nonlinear probe grid. Stop if gate fails.
content_diagnostics: Finite kernel probe on four factors using actual phi slots: all versus validation-selected one slot per modality, sample and all-mean modes. Raw flattened private conditional increment separate. Linear probes for G shared/private accessibility and nuisance in private. No probe result is MI or biological semantics.
stability: Every-step gradient norms, finite losses, fraction of batches with any raw slot mean above capacity, mean active-slot fraction, mean rate, per-slot activation counts; no automatic intervention on failed trajectories.
prediction_and_readout: Five paired draws; private N0 replacement/donor permutation and one-slot N0 replacement are fixed-readout sensitivities only. Latent Bayes logits are privileged controls, not clinical baselines.
selection: All arms reported. No eta chosen by these test results;3 paired seeds exploratory, no significance/equivalence claim. More rate pressure may remove useful content or worsen scores.
outputs: Public scalar aggregates/hashes; synthetic arrays and states only in fresh ignored local_evidence directory. Save trained rows before expensive probes so completion can be audited without rerunning training.
